description: Variables listed in 'accepted_ranges' are compared against a range accepted by subject matter experts, e.g. from the literature, instead of against the recorded expected results. During an end-to-end testing run with accepted ranges enabled (the 'use_accepted_ranges' task setting, on by default), every numerical value of each listed variable must fall within its inclusive 'min' and 'max' bounds: a value outside the range is reported as a failure, and differences between a listed variable and its recorded expected results are not. Other keys of a range entry, e.g. a literature reference, are kept and echoed in the end-to-end comparison results next to the observed minimum and maximum of the variable. Variable names must exactly match keys in the 'expected_results' of this input set's e2e_json_*_filter.json files, e.g. "AnimalModuleReporter.report_animal_population_statistics.population_number_of_cows": {"min": 500, "max": 1500, "reference": "..."}.
